why_representative: It was source_preserving_bridge_only before the pilot and the old RGV-001 bridge explicitly recommended splitting.
It is small enough for a single bounded pass: 253 pre-edit lines and 15 pre-edit spans, below the 400-line window threshold.

It contains representative mixed content: GUI surface requirements, routing constraints, data-model identity modernization, validation rules, compatibility/stale tier-era dispositions, and cross-owner hints.
It is implementation-relevant but not so broad that Phase 2A would become a hidden broad conversion.
